senses.gloss:
अन्य अन्य, अस्, आ, अत् (according to native
authorities fr. rt. अन्, but more probably from a pronom.
base अ or अन्), other, different; (with abl. or as the
last member of a compound) other than, different
from opposed to; another; another person; one of
a number; अन्य अन्य or एक अन्य, the one, the
other [cf. Zend anya; Armen. ail; Lat. alius; Goth.
aljis, Them. alja; Gr. ἄλλος for ἄλ-ϳος cf. also
ἔνιοι].
—अन्य-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, loving another.
—अन्य-कारुका, f. a worm bred in excrement.
—अन्य-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, or अन्य-कारित, अस्, आ,
अम्, done by another.
—अन्य-क्षेत्र, अम्, n. an-
other territory or sphere.
—अन्य-ग, अस्, आ, अम्, or
अन्य-गामिन्, ई, इनी, इ, going to another, adulterous.
—अन्य-गोत्र, अस्, आ, अम्, of a different family.
—अन्य-चित्त, अस्, आ, अम्, whose mind is fixed on
some one or something else.
—अन्य-चोदित, अस्, आ,
अम्, moved by another.
—अन्यच्-च (˚यद्-च), ind.
and another, besides, moreover, on the contrary.
—अन्य-ज or अन्य-जात, अस्, आ, अम्, born of another
(family, &c.), of a different origin.
—अन्य-जन्मन्,
अ, n. another birth, being born again, metempsy-
chosis.
—अन्य-ता, f. difference.
—अन्यत्-काम, अस्,
आ, अम्, desirous of something else.
—अन्यत्-कृ, to
make a mistake in reading, &c.
—अन्यद्-अर्थ
or अन्यार्थ (˚य-अर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, having another
meaning, purpose, sense.
—अन्य-दुर्वह, अस्, आ,
अम्, difficult to be borne by another.
—अन्य-देवत
or अन्य-देवत्य or अन्य-दैवत, अस्, आ, अम्,
having another divinity, i. e. addressed to another
divinity.
—अन्य-धर्म, अस्, m. different character-
istic; characteristic of another; (अस्, आ, अम्,), having dif-
ferent characteristics.
—अन्य-धी, ईस्, ईस्, इ, one whose
mind is alienated (from God).
—अन्य-नाभि, इस्, इस्,
इ, of another family.
—अन्य-पर, अस्, आ, अम्, de-
voted to something else, zealous in something else.
—अन्य-पुष्ट or अन्य-भृत अस्, आ, m. f. the
kokila or Indian cuckoo, supposed to be reared by
the crow.
—अन्य-पूर्वा, f. a woman previously pro-
mised or betrothed to one and married to another.
—अन्य-भृत्, त्, m. a crow (‘nourishing another;’
the crow being supposed to sit upon the eggs of the
kokila).
—अन्य-मनस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, or अन्य-म-
नस्क or अन्य-मानस, अस्, आ, अम्, one whose mind
is fixed on something else, absent, fickle, versatile;
having another mind in one's self, possessed by a
demon.
—अन्य-मातृ-ज, अस्, m. a half-brother, who
has the same father but another mother.
—अन्य-
राजन्, आ, आ, अ, having another for king, subject to
another.
—अन्य-राष्ट्रीय, अस्, आ, अम्, from another
kingdom, belonging to another kingdom.
—अन्य-
रूप, अम्, n. another form; (एण), in another form,
disguised; (अस्, आ, अम्), changed, altered.
—अन्य-
रूपिन्, ई, इणी, इ, having another shape.
—अन्य-
लिङ्ग or अन्य-लिङ्गक, अस्, आ, अम्, having the
gender of another (word, viz. of the substantive), an
adjective.
—अन्य-वर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, having another
colour.
—अन्य-वाप, अस्, m. the kokila or Indian
cuckoo (‘sowing for others,’ i. e. leaving his eggs in
the nests of other birds).
—अन्य-वीज-ज or अन्य-
वीज-समुद्भव or अन्य-वीजोत्पन्न (˚ज-उत्˚),
अस्, m. (‘born from the seed of another’), an adopted
son.
—अन्य-व्रत, अस्, m., Ved. following other
(than Vedic) observances; devoted to other (gods),
infidel, unbelieving.
—अन्य-शाखक, अस्, m. a
Brāhman who has left his school; an apostate.
—अन्य-सङ्गम, अस्, m. intercourse with another,
adulterous intercourse.
—अन्य-साधारण, अस्, आ,
अम्, common to others.
—अन्य-स्त्री-ग, अस्,
m. going to another's wife, an adulterer.
—अन्या-
दृक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, or अन्य-दृश्, क्, क्, क्, or अन्य-
दृश, अस्, ई, अम्, of another kind, like another.
—अन्याधीन (˚य-अध्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, subject to
others, dependent.
—अन्याश्रयण (˚य-आश्˚), अम्,
[]
n. going to another (as an inheritance).
—अन्या-
श्रित (˚य-आस्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, gone to another.
—अन्यासक्त (˚य-आस्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, intent on some-
thing else.
—अन्यासाधारण (˚य-अस्˚), अस्, ई, अम्,
not common to another, peculiar.
—अन्योढा (˚य-
ऊढ्˚), f. married to another, another's wife.
—अन्-
योत्पन्न (˚य-उत्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, begotten by another.
—अन्योदर्य (˚य-उद्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, born from
another womb; (अस्), m. a step-mother's son.

अन्या अ-न्या, f., Ved. (न्या contracted fr.
निया ?), not drying up (as the milk of a cow ?); or
अन्या, f. of अन्य, other (the accent being altered ?).
अन्यक, अस्, m. another, other.

अन्य-तम, अस्, आ, अम्, any one of many, either,
any.

अन्य-तर, अस्, आ, अत्, either of two, other, differ-
ent; अन्यतर अन्यतर, the one, the other;
अन्यतरस्याम्, loc. f. either way.
—अन्यतर-
तस्, ind. on one of two sides.
—अन्यतरतो-दन्त,
अस्, आ, अम्, having teeth on one side (only).
—अन्य-
तरे-द्युस्, ind. on either of two days.

अन्य-तस्, ind. from another; from another mo-
tive; on one side (अन्यतः अन्यतः, on the one,
on the other side); elsewhere; on the other side, on
the contrary, in one direction; towards some other
place.
—अन्यत-एत, एतस्, एनी, m. f., Ved. variegated
on one side.
—अन्यतः-क्ष्णुत्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. sharp
on one side.
—अन्यतः-प्लक्षा, f., N. of a Lotus
pond in Kurukṣetra.
—अन्यतो-घातिन्, ई, m., Ved.
striking in one direction.
—अन्यतो-ऽरण्य (˚तस्-अर्˚),
अम्, n., Ved. a land which is woody here and there,
or only on one side (?).
—अन्यतो-वात, अस्, m. a
certain disease of the eye.
अन्यतस्त्य, अस्, m. opponent, adversary.

अन्य-त्र, ind. (equivalent to अन्यस्मिन्, loc.
of अन्य), elsewhere, in another place (with abl.);
on another occasion; (as last member of a comp.) at
another time than; otherwise, in another manner;
to another place; except, without [cf. Goth. aljathrô].
—अन्यत्र-मनस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, whose mind is di-
rected to something else, inattentive.

अन्य-था, ind. otherwise, in a different manner
(with अतस्, इतस् or ततस् = in a manner different
from this; अन्यथा अन्यथा, in one way, in another
way); inaccurately, untruly, falsely, erroneously; from
another motive; in the contrary case, otherwise [cf.
Lat. aliuta].
—अन्यथा-कार, अस्, m. doing other-
wise, changing; (अम्), ind. otherwise, in a different
manner.
—अन्यथा-कृ, to act otherwise, alter, vio-
late (a law), destroy (a hope), &c.
—अन्यथा-कृत,
अस्, आ, अम्, changed.
—अन्यथा-ख्याति, इस्, f. erro-
neous conception of spirit; title of a philosophical
work.
—अन्यथा-त्व, अम्, n. an opposite state of the
case, difference.
—अन्यथा-भाव, अस्, m. alteration,
difference.
—अन्यथा-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, changed.
—अन्यथा-वादिन् or अन्य-वादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, speak-
ing differently; (ई), m. speaking inconsistently; (in
law) prevaricating or a prevaricator.
—अन्यथा-
वृत्ति, इस्, इस्, इ, altered, disturbed by strong emotion.
—अन्यथा-सिद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, wrongly defined,
wrongly proved or established; effected otherwise, un-
essential.
—अन्यथासिद्ध-त्व, अम्, n. or अन्यथा-
सिद्धि, इस्, f. wrong arguing, wrong demonstration;
that demonstration in which arguments are referred
to which are not the true causes.
—अन्यथा-स्तोत्र,
अम्, n. irony. — (From अन्यथा comes the nom. verb
अन्यथय, P. अन्यथयति, -यितुम्, to alter.)

अन्य-दा, ind. at another time; sometimes; one
day, once; in another case [cf. Old Slav. inogda,
inŭda].
अन्यदीय, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to another.
अन्यर्हि, ind. at another time.

अन्ये-द्युस्, ind. on the other day, on the following
day; the other day, once.
—अन्येद्युष्क, अस्, आ,
अम्, occurring every other day, daily, diurnal; (अस्),
m. a quotidian fever.

अन्योन्य or अन्यो-ऽन्य, अस्, आ, अम्, one another,
mutual [this word is said to be fr. अन्यस्, nom. sing.
m., and अन्य; cf. परस्पर. In most cases, ac-
cordingly, it will be found that the first अन्य may be
regarded as the subject of the sentence, while the
latter assumes the acc., inst., gen., or loc. cases as re-
quired by the verb; there are many instances, however,
in which the first अन्य, originally a nominative, must
[]
be regarded as equivalent to an oblique case]; अन्यो-
न्यम् or अन्योन्य-तस्, ind. mutually.
—अन्योन्य-
कलह, अस्, m. mutual quarrel.
—अन्योन्य-घात, अस्,
m. mutual conflict, killing one another.
—अन्योन्य-
पक्ष-नयन, अम्, n. transposing (of numbers) from
one side to another.
—अन्योन्य-भेद, अस्, m. mutual
division or enmity.
—अन्योन्य-मिथुन, अम्, n. mu-
tual union; (अस्), m. united mutually.
—अन्योन्य-वि-
भाग, अस्, m. mutual partition (of an inheritance).
—अ-
न्योन्य-वृत्ति, इस्, m. mutual effect of one upon another.
—अन्योन्य-व्यतिकर, अस्, m. reciprocal action, re-
lation or influence.
—अन्योन्य-संश्रय, अस्, m.
reciprocal relation (of cause and effect).
—अन्योन्य-
सापेक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, mutually relating.
—अन्योन्य-
हाराभिहत (˚र-अभ्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, (two quantities)
mutually multiplied by their denominators.
—अन्यो-
न्यापहृत (˚य-अप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, taken or secreted
from one another, taken secretly.
—अन्योन्याभाव
(˚य-अभ्˚), अस्, m. mutual non-existence, mutual
negation, relative difference.
—अन्योन्याश्रय (˚य-
आश्˚), अस्, m. mutual or reciprocal support, connec-
tion or dependance; mutually depending.
—अन्यो-
न्याश्रित (˚य-आश्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, mutually supported
or depending.
—अन्योन्योक्ति (˚य-उक्˚), इस्, f. con-
versation.

अन्यङ्ग अ-न्यङ्ग, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. spotless.
—अ-न्यङ्ग-श्वेत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. white and
without spot (as a sacrificial animal).

अन्यच्च, अन्यतस्, अन्यथा, अन्यदा, अन्योन्य।
See under अन्य.

अन्याय अ-न्याय, अस्, m. unjust or unlawful
action; impropriety, indecorum; irregularity, disor-
der.
—अन्याय-वर्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, or अन्याय-वृत्त,
अस्, आ, अम्, acting unjustly; following evil courses.

अ-न्यायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, or अ-न्याय्य, अस्, आ, अम्, unjust,
improper, indecorous, unbecoming.

अन्यून अ-न्यून, अस्, आ, अम्, not defective,
entire, complete.
—अ-न्यूनाधिक (˚न-अध्˚), अस्,
आ, अम्, not too little and not too much; neither de-
ficient nor excessive.

अन्योकस् अ-न्य्-ओकस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, not remaining
in one's own (ओकस्) habitation.

आन्यतरेय आन्यतरेय, अस्, m., N. of a
grammarian.

अन्यथय, Nom. P. (fr. अन्यथा), अन्यथ-
यति, &c., to change, alter.

अन्या-दृक्ष; for ‘अन्य-दृश्, अन्य-दृश’
read अन्या-द्˚.
